subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/440eca00881fe5ceb55857b6a1197856346080a9e12f06340b25a3afcc3669a7.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Dark square is shifting one step ahead inside the figure.(Clockwise)
 
• Empty square is shifting one step ahead inside the figure (Anticlockwise).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f09f3d610305b0b0cbfd39811ecf7991cb354dd7c52af51cf5383c96d5584e92.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
